title: DST WISE-KIRAN Postdoctoral Fellowship for Women in Science
brief_summary: Fellowship opportunity for unemployed or career-break women scientists holding a Ph.D. to re-enter frontier research in science, mathematics, and engineering.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Re-entry and Fellowship for Women Researchers with Ph.D.

eligibility.min_qualification: Ph.D. in Basic or Applied Sciences / Engineering
eligible_institutions: Any recognized Indian University / National Institute / Research Lab
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Unemployed women scientists and engineers aged between 27 to 45 years with a Ph.D. degree.

financials.raw_budget_text: Monthly fellowship of Rs. 55,000 + HRA + Rs. 2,00,000 annual research grant for 3 years.

full_text_content:
DST WOMEN IN SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING (WISE) POSTDOCTORAL FELLOWSHIP
Target: Ph.D. women scientists seeking independent research opportunities.
Fellowship: Rs. 55,000/month + research grant. Rolling call open until 31 December 2026.

title: DBT-BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG) for MedTech & Bio-Innovation
brief_summary: Ignition grant for innovative biotech, healthcare, agricultural, and biomedical ideas to establish proof-of-concept and foster startup creation.

eligibility.min_qualification: Graduate in Biotech, Life Sciences, Medicine, or Engineering
eligible_institutions: Startups (< 5 yrs old), Individual Innovators, Incubatees, Researchers
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Indian individuals, research scholars, faculty entrepreneurs, or registered Indian startups with <= 5 years incorporation.

financials.raw_budget_text: Up to Rs. 50 Lakhs grant-in-aid for 18 months to reach Proof of Concept (PoC).

full_text_content:
DEPARTMENT OF BIOTECHNOLOGY (DBT) & BIRAC
BIOTECHNOLOGY IGNITION GRANT (BIG) CALL 28
Objective: Enable commercialization of bio-innovations and support early-stage MedTech startups.
Funding: Grant of up to Rs. 50,00,000 (50 Lakhs) for 18 months.
Closing Date: 31st August 2026 (Extended to 15th September 2026).

title: ANRF Teachers Associateship for Research Excellence (TARE)
brief_summary: Facilitates mobility of faculty working in state universities and colleges to carry out collaborative research at premier host institutions (IITs, IISc, IISERs, National Labs).

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Capacity Building & Premier Institute Collaborative Research

eligible_institutions: State Universities, Colleges, and Private Academic Institutions
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Faculty from State Universities and Colleges aged up to 45 years who wish to collaborate with mentors in CFTIs / IISc / IITs.

financials.raw_budget_text: Research grant of Rs. 5 Lakhs per annum plus Rs. 15,000 per month research fellowship for 3 years.

full_text_content:
ANRF TEACHERS ASSOCIATESHIP FOR RESEARCH EXCELLENCE (TARE) 2026
Objective: Tap untapped research potential of state universities and colleges.
Grant: Rs. 5 Lakhs/year grant + Rs. 15,000/month research allowance.
Eligibility: Regular faculty with Ph.D., age <= 45 years. Deadline: 30 Sept 2026.

title: NSP Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for Higher Technical Education
brief_summary: Financial assistance for meritorious undergraduate and postgraduate students enrolled in professional engineering, medical, and technology degree programs.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Merit-cum-Means Financial Support for Higher Technical Education

eligibility.min_qualification: Class 12th / Diploma passed with minimum 60% marks
eligible_institutions: Recognized Universities, Institutes offering AICTE/MCI/UGC approved technical courses
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Students admitted to 1st year of professional degree courses (B.Tech, MBBS, B.Pharm, MCA, MBA) with minimum 60% in 10+2 / Diploma.

financials.raw_budget_text: Monthly scholarship of Rs. 3,000 for girls (Rs. 36,000/year) and Rs. 2,500 for boys (Rs. 30,000/year) disbursed directly to bank account.

full_text_content:
NATIONAL SCHOLARSHIP PORTAL (NSP) - MINISTRY OF EDUCATION
PRIME MINISTER'S SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME (PMSS) 2026
Target: Meritorious UG/PG students in professional and engineering courses.
Benefit: Rs. 36,000 annually for female students and Rs. 30,000 for male students.
Deadline: 31st October 2026 (Extended till 30th November 2026).

title: AICTE Research Promotion Scheme (RPS) for Technical Institutions
brief_summary: Financial support to AICTE-approved engineering and polytechnic institutions to upgrade research infrastructure, undertake innovation in IoT, Robotics, EV technologies, and publish patents.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Next-Generation EV, IoT, and Embedded VLSI Systems

eligibility.min_qualification: Master's or Ph.D. in Engineering / Technology
eligible_institutions: AICTE Approved Technical Institutions / Engineering Colleges
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Full-time faculty of AICTE approved technical institutions with minimum 5 years teaching/research experience.

financials.raw_budget_text: Grant-in-aid up to Rs. 25 Lakhs for modernization of laboratory equipment and research consumables.

full_text_content:
ALL INDIA COUNCIL FOR TECHNICAL EDUCATION (AICTE)
RESEARCH PROMOTION SCHEME (RPS) 2026-27
Objective: Promoting research in technical institutes to create innovation and patents.
Maximum Grant: Rs. 25 Lakhs over a 3-year timeline.
Eligibility: Regular faculty members in AICTE-approved engineering institutions.
Deadline: 15 November 2026.

title: CSIR Extra Mural Research (EMR-II) Scheme in Biotechnology & Health Sciences
brief_summary: Extramural financial support for sponsored research projects focused on affordable diagnostic devices, molecular therapeutics, bioinformatics pipelines, and infectious disease management.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Translational Biotechnology and Affordable Healthcare Diagnostics

eligibility.min_qualification: Ph.D. or MD/MS with active research track record
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Faculty members and scientists with permanent employment in recognized Indian universities, medical colleges, and research institutes.

financials.raw_budget_text: Total project grant up to Rs. 45 Lakhs including Junior/Senior Research Fellow (JRF/SRF) monthly fellowship and contingency.

full_text_content:
COUNCIL OF SCIENTIFIC AND INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH (CSIR)
EXTRA MURAL RESEARCH (EMR) GRANTS 2026
Domain: Biotechnology, Genomics, Drug Discovery, and Public Health Technologies.
Grant Cap: Rs. 45 Lakhs for 3 years + JRF manpower at Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA.
Eligibility: Permanent faculty / research scientists. Closing date: 15-09-2026, extended to 30-09-2026.

title: ANRF Promoting Opportunities for Women in Exploratory Research (POWER) Grant
brief_summary: Encouraging emerging women researchers in STEM disciplines to undertake exploratory and breakthrough basic/applied scientific research with dedicated project funding and networking mentorship.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: Empowering Women Scientists in Exploratory STEM Research

eligibility.min_qualification: Ph.D. degree in Science, Engineering or Medicine
eligible_institutions: All Indian Universities and Colleges recognized by UGC/AICTE
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Open exclusively to Indian women scientists with regular faculty positions in recognized universities or research laboratories. Must have Ph.D. with at least two publications.

financials.raw_budget_text: Level I: Rs. 30 Lakhs for 3 years for CFTI/National Lab researchers; Level II: Rs. 25 Lakhs for State/Private universities.

full_text_content:
ANUSANDHAN NATIONAL RESEARCH FOUNDATION (ANRF)
POWER RESEARCH GRANTS FOR WOMEN SCIENTISTS 2026
Objective: To mitigate gender disparity in science and engineering research funding by funding active women scientists.
Funding Ceiling: Level-1 grants up to Rs. 30,00,000/- for 3 years.
Eligibility: Regular female faculty/researchers aged up to 55 years holding a Ph.D. degree.
Closing Date: Proposals close on 31 October 2026.

title: DST Core Research Grant (CRG) in Advanced Materials and AI
brief_summary: Call for research proposals in emerging areas of artificial intelligence, semiconductor materials, clean energy, and quantum technologies. Supports individual PIs and collaborative groups from recognized Indian academic institutions.

ontology_tags.thematic_thrust: AI for Scientific Discovery and Advanced Materials

eligibility.min_qualification: Ph.D. in Science or Engineering with regular faculty/scientist appointment
eligibility.raw_eligibility_text: Applicants should hold a regular academic/research position in a recognized Indian academic institution or national laboratory with a Ph.D. degree and at least 3 SCI indexed journal publications.

financials.raw_budget_text: Maximum financial assistance up to Rs. 60 Lakhs for a duration of 3 years including 10% institutional overheads and equipment budget.

full_text_content:
DEPARTMENT OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (DST)
CALL FOR PROPOSALS: CORE RESEARCH GRANT (CRG) 2026
1. Objective: To promote individual-centric competitive research in high-impact national thrust areas including AI, materials, and quantum computing.
2. Eligibility: The Principal Investigator (PI) must hold a regular faculty position with Ph.D. in Science/Engineering. Age limit is 60 years. Co-PI from industry is welcome but not mandatory.
3. Budget Ceiling: Maximum funding up to Rs. 60,00,000 (INR 60 Lakhs) over 36 months.
4. Deadlines: Call opens on 01-07-2026. Proposals must be submitted via the online portal on or before 30-09-2026. Extended deadline: 15-10-2026.
5. Institution: CFTIs, Central/State Universities, and NAAC Accredited Private Institutions.
